ref: ttnn/ttnn/operations/rms_norm/op_design.md Block Operation Realization row 2 (lookahead TileAddressing::Offset) + CB table cb_x
what: Design realizes x_block_depth=2 + combine lookahead as one 2-block cb_x ring addressed with an Offset base for block b+1; indexed CB reads cannot wrap the ring (LLK cb_access_within_bounds), so b+1 is unreachable whenever block b sits in the second half. Same table sizes cb_x by slice_w_tiles for all cores while the last W member pushes core_w_tiles per row, which misaligns the ring.
suggest: Planner reference (blocking-model.md / l1-footprint-discipline.md) should state: indexed CB access never wraps; simultaneous access to 2 blocks needs two CBs (ping-pong) or a capacity where the blocks are always contiguous; per-row push counts must divide CB capacity.
